messages:
Ravi: Quick sync: planning AWS KMS integration for Redwood Private VPC. Main items: BYOK grant flow, DEK cache TTL/eviction, audit schema for grants, and emergency rotation. Short thoughts?
Elena: For BYOK prefer CreateGrant -> save grantId in our DB. Avoid editing customer key policies. Grants make revoke straightforward.
Marco: Agree. Cache plaintext DEKs in-memory only, TTL=30-60s. Evict and zero memory on removal. Track cache hit/miss metrics.
Priya: Audit requirements: CloudTrail + our app events. App events should include keyArn, grantId (if used), principalArn, operation, objectId, correlationId, and outcome. Write immutable event blobs to S3 with SSE and checksum.
Ravi: Rotation strategy: lazy rewrap on access + background batch for cold objects. Provide rewrap progress in Console. For huge stores, rate-limit rewrap jobs per-customer.
Elena: Incident flow for suspected compromise: 1) Disable CMK 2) Retire grants 3) Pause affected customer serve 4) Rewrap hot objects to replacement key first 5) Export signed audit bundle for customer and SOC.
Marco: RBAC: product wants a support role that can GenerateDataKey for recreate tests but not Decrypt. Create explicit IAM policy allowing kms:GenerateDataKey and denying kms:Decrypt & kms:ReEncrypt*. Add unit tests asserting deny.
Priya: Edge: simultaneous rotate + access -> ensure rewrap is idempotent. Use object rewrap_version and optimistic lock to avoid double writes. Instrument retries with backoff.
Ravi: BYOK onboarding: provide customers a sample CreateGrant CLI and an API callback option. Document required grant actions and conditions (aws:SourceVpc, aws:SourceVpce).
Elena: Vulnerability triage note: if DEK cache library has a CVE, rotate managed CMKs immediately and notify BYOK customers with guidance. Revoke grants tied to affected keys.
Priya: Action items:
- Marco: implement in-memory DEK cache zero-on-evict + metrics (ETA 3d)
- Elena: spec grant DB schema + retire reconciliation loop (ETA 2d)
- Ravi: draft incident runbook for CMK compromise + signed audit bundle format (ETA 1d)
- Priya: update onboarding docs with grant examples and callback flow (ETA 2d)
kms-bot: Checklist updated: https://go.redwood/priv-kms-checklist (eyes)
Ravi: thanks all, pls ack if you can join a 30m working session tomorrow to pair on grant API design. :thumbsup:
